content.overview: Section 12 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 makes a marriage voidable (valid until annulled) on the grounds of non-consummation owing to the respondent’s impotence, contravention of s. 5(ii) (mental capacity), consent obtained by force or fraud, or pregnancy of the respondent by another person at the time of marriage. Strict statutory bars and limitation periods apply to the force/fraud and pregnancy grounds.
